blocks.title: Our Engagement Models
text: We offer practical and transparent pricing models to ensure you get the best value for your investment.

The fixed-price model is ideal for projects with clear, predefined goals and requirements. It works best for small businesses or medium-sized projects with a set budget. The scope, timeline, and deliverables are agreed upon upfront.
bullets: Predefined budgets, objectives, and deliverables.
Billing is based on completed milestones.
Changes to the scope require client approval, ensuring no budget overruns.
Both the cost and timeline are fixed, minimizing risks for both parties

text: The Time & Material model is ideal for projects where the scope is unclear or constantly changing. It allows for flexibility, as the client pays based on the amount of work done, whether hourly, daily, weekly, or monthly. This model is great when it’s difficult to break the project into stages or define fixed requirements.
bullets: Suitable for projects where requirements are frequently updated.
Clients can pay based on time spent (hourly, daily, weekly, or monthly)
Clients can adjust resources or explore new activities as the project evolves
Resources can be modified depending on the project's changing needs.

text: The Dedicated Hiring Model is perfect for projects that need rapid scaling or specialized expertise over the long term. It’s ideal when you have tight deadlines, need to quickly expand teams, or require developers skilled in emerging technologies. This model gives you full control over processes, resources, and strategy. It’s flexible and scalable, making it a great choice for businesses with varying needs.
bullets: Best for clients with internal teams overseeing projects.
Get dedicated developers to focus solely on your project
Best model for clients with in-house staff to manage the projects
Developers work exclusively for your team

blocks.title: Development Process & Methodology
text: At Pelicans, we follow industry-standard processes. We work closely with clients at every stage of the SDLC, ensuring clear communication and seamless project execution. Our offshore team takes full ownership, delivering high-quality, cost-effective solutions while continuously improving our processes.

At Pelicans, we follow the Agile Development Methodology to build software that meets your evolving business needs. Using SCRUM and Kanban practices, our team works closely with you at every stage of the project — from planning to delivery. This approach helps us deliver high-quality software faster, with regular updates and flexibility to adapt to changes. We use tools like JIRA, Assembla, and Bitbucket to manage tasks and ensure everything runs smoothly.
bullets: Agile process for faster and flexible software delivery.
Regular collaboration with clients at every project stage.
Transparent progress tracking and quick feedback.
Project management tools like JIRA, Assembla, and Bitbucket for smooth execution.

text: At Pelicans, we adopt the Iterative Development approach by breaking down the project into smaller, manageable modules. Each module is developed and delivered in phases, allowing us to gather valuable feedback from stakeholders at every release. Every iteration follows a structured process where feedback from one phase is incorporated into the next, ensuring continuous improvement. Each phase delivers a specific set of features based on project requirements, resulting in a more stable and high-quality software product.
bullets: Project divided into smaller, manageable modules.
Stakeholder feedback collected at every release.
Each iteration improves the previous version.
Delivers a more stable, high-quality software product.

text: The Waterfall Development model is a traditional, step-by-step approach that follows a clear sequence: Requirements, Design, Development, Testing, Deployment, and Maintenance. Each phase must be completed and approved before moving on to the next, ensuring smooth project execution. Proper documentation and a detailed project plan are essential for the success of small to mid-sized software development projects. At Pelicans, we offer a customized Waterfall development model, working collaboratively with clients to define clear requirements and provide ongoing insights, ensuring project success.
bullets: Follows a sequential process from Requirements to Maintenance.
Each phase must be signed off before proceeding to the next.
Emphasizes clear documentation and project planning.
Collaborative approach to ensure continuous feedback and project success.
